criteria.requirement: Add diagnostics.parse_with_report using the actual HTMLParser and returning tree/errors/encoding/compat_mode/truncated. Collect structured real position/code/details errors, support first-error policy through original strict ParseError and ignore policy hiding reports, and cap report entries with explicit truncation without mislabeling it a parsing resource budget. Preserve namespace/backend/encoding kwargs and ordinary html5lib.parse behavior; recovered trees remain equivalent, valid documents do not gain errors and invalid options reject before parsing. Do not invent source spans or suppress strict failures as successful output.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
